user.title: Connect to VERSA
user.description: Disconnect DLOADX before connecting. Only input states are read. The program opening PIN is not needed.

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: Re-enter both identifiers and the ETHM key. The existing connection will be briefly stopped during validation.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address and port, and disconnect DLOADX.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected or invalid response. Check both identifiers and the ETHM key.
error.invalid_identifier: Identifiers must contain exactly 8 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_key: Use 1–12 printable ASCII characters for the ETHM key.
error.invalid_inputs: Use input numbers from 1 to 30, for example 1-8,10.
error.invalid_interval: Choose an interval from 1 to 60 seconds.
error.wrong_panel: The VERSA identifier must match this entry. Remove and add the integration to use a different panel.
error.cannot_unload: The running integration could not be stopped. Try restarting Home Assistant.
